Hello Tavern Dwellers! We're so excited to bring you the biggest update ever to Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers - the Doubling Down 2.0 Update!
This update adds 4 new floors, complete with new foes, events, and music!
After making your initial choice at the end of the Tavern, you will now have a second choice at the end of VIP Area and Casino.
After VIP Area, choose between the existing path through Head Office and Hope, or a new path through Laboratory and Apathy.
After Casino, choose between the existing path through the Dungeon and Despair, or a new path through Surveillance and Anxiety.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012939/30ba39796cba167bce8a618d5643277628bb0748.png"]

Lucky Charms are new items that are collected during your run that have permanent, always-on effects. You'll be given one at the start of Jack's Tavern, then one in the middle of each floor after the Tavern. As you go, they'll be added to your Collection.
Bosses will also have Lucky Charms at Double Down! and higher difficulties.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012939/f6ce0f2f08b424a317b6ef951a717027c3d4de02.png"]

Daily Runs - a randomly chosen deck, and three randomly chosen modifiers
Custom Runs - choose from a list of modifiers, and input your own seed

items.text: Hello Tavern Dwellers! Mike from Purple Moss Collectors here.

In both 2024 and 2025 we did fun April Fools updates for Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers. 2024 added the Glitched Deck, and changed Tavern Counterfeiter to allow turning numbered cards into Glitched Cards. In 2025 we added the Signature Glitched Deck, along with some glitchy Easter Eggs while using that deck. And both years after April Fools ended the changes stuck around permanently.
Usually at this time of year we'd be getting ready to push the release button on the April Fools update - but not this time!

It's good news though, the reason we aren't doing it is because we are right in the middle of working on a really big update for later this year! Basically, we want this update to be the very best it can be and so didn't want to get distracted with an April Fools update.
Sorry to all the April Fools Enjoyers, pinky promise we'll do one next year.

In this update, the next of the series of smaller patches since the big v1.2 update, I've added a back up system to make sure no one else has their progress file wiped. This had affected a few players who had the game crash or had a power outage during the save operation. Finally, there are a heap of minor improvements and bug fixes.
The update after this one will improve the controller support and navigation, so please look out for that one if you play with a controller or on a Steam Deck!

items.text: Less wasteful exploitation

overhauls the system for exploiting cards so that the game will check if the card can be exploited before exploiting it, meaning that Advantage is not wasted if the card's condition is not met. e.g. exploiting a Time Card while having no 9 or 5 in play will not cost 1 Advantage anymore. In v1.1 if you played Bounce Card from hand it would ensure that it would not select itself since it felt bad to play it from hand and have it immediately bounce back. In v1.2 I added "or exploit" to Bounce Card, so at the same time I made it so that it can select itself. Otherwise when exploiting you can reliably use all Advantage to clear all your played cards. Now I have changed it so that these are treated slightly differently, so the card will use the v1.1 behaviour when played and the v1.2 behaviour when exploited. This means you still don't feel bad when playing from hand but you can't abuse via exploit. Best of both worlds!

items.text: Hello Tavern Dwellers!
It's been just over a week since the Tavern opened, and it's been amazing to see you all enjoying your time with the game so far!

There has been lots of feedback coming through about every aspect of Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers, and this update addresses a big chunk of them. A big area of feedback has been to do with the balance, which has been significantly overhauled in this update.
foe decks being too consistently strong compared to the player at the same stage in a run
foes having the ability to scale out of control too easily, particularly when it comes to shields
some events being too punishing / not rewarding enough
it taking too long to start building synergies in your deck
winning being too reliant on finding healing cards
each run taking too much time
bug fixes

If you wish to join our public Beta to test the upcoming changes and provide feedback, you can do so by right clicking on the game in your Steam library, going to Properties, then Betas, then selecting "public_beta" from the dropdown menu.
We hope you enjoy the changes!

I am beyond excited to share the latest update of Dungeons & Degenerate Gamblers with you!

The 21st version of the demo had to be a special update, so me, the Yogscast artists (Jack, Nina-Serena, and Harry), and our composer (Element27) have been spending the necessary time in the tavern's kitchen cooking up the best and biggest update to the demo ever. So, without further ado, here is what is new:
A complete art overhaul that preserves the pixel art aesthetic, but with a grimier, dank twist
A brand new, dynamic soundtrack that changes with each game of blackjack
A whole bunch of new cards, including a big set of Face cards
Reworks of lots of existing cards, including some of the weaker Tarot cards
A new card type: Foil cards
New encounters
A collection for tracking the cards you have added to your deck
Customisable ID Card portrait

New art and animations for chips and Advantage
New art for every Unique Chip

New damage and grime on the cards themselves, which is randomised for each run
Base resolution increased to 640x360 (was previously 480x270)
Music changes
A whole new soundtrack, with a unique track for each floor
A new track is added to the current track during each encounter, keeping the soundtrack fresh for every run
Keywords
Several common effects have been changed to use keywords:
On click -> Exploit
+1 value if this doesn't cause a bust -> Rounds up
Set your score to match your bust limit -> Instant blackjack
Set your score to match opponent's score -> Instant draw
Permanently remove card from your deck -> Shred
View the next X cards in your draw pile -> Foresight X

Discard without enacting 'on discard' effects -> Quick discard

Customisable ID Card
You can now customise your portrait using the ID Card on the title screen
More customisations will be coming in the full release!
New settings and pause menu
Adds a brand new settings screen, with a few new options
Animation speed - defaults to 1
Language (currently English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese are available, but more will be added) - defaults to Steam language, falls back to English
Glitched Card visual effect intensity - defaults to 3
Smoking allowed/no smoking - defaults to no smoking

The pause menu is now accessible at any point during a run (instead of just during encounters) by clicking the Escape key, or clicking the logo of the current floor
Quality of Life improvements
Basic rules of the game are now displayed on the table of the tavern
Several interactable elements (such as viewing your discard pile) have a red exclamation mark if you have never used them, to help new players discover them
Adds a party animation to the Score Card when you have a blackjack
Adds an error message and plays a failure sound effect when a card effect has no valid targets (e.g. Business Card played when opponent has no cards in play)
Better controller and keyboard navigation on some interfaces
If running in windowed mode, the window is now centred to the centre of the screen on start up
The win and loss screens have both been reworked to make starting another run easier
You can now view your deck on the loss screen
Removes the lock icon from the mystery reward card
Other improvements
Adds the "of Nothings" starting deck
Hovering cards is much snappier
Unhovering cards is much bouncier
Better deck/pile preview that allows for more cards to be displayed at once
Deck/draw pile previews are now sorted by order in the Collection book, which improves grouping of similar cards
Adds a fancy unfurling animation to the Fortune Teller event
Optimisation on cards so that they can be loaded quicker, this greatly improves game performance when playing with decks with 100s of cards
Lots of changes to card descriptions to reduce the length and complexity of the effect descriptions
Lots of improvements to story text
Makes the whole ID Card hoverable and clickable
Adds new sound effect for Slot Machine shop
Bug fixes
fixes a bug where Transit Card was adding to the end of the opponent's draw pile instead of a random position
fixes a bug where the card hover 'tick' sound could play too often
fixes a bug where cards that had a condition before they could be played from hand (i.e. Dark Mage) would use up 1 Advantage even if that condition meant that they weren't played
fixes a bug where Glitched Card would remember values from previously copied cards, leading to strange behaviour when the new card needed to access those values
fixes a bug where cards created by Four Mana Seven Seven were not triggering 'bust limit exceeded' effects
fixes a bug where you could deal lower than expected damage with a low base damage but high damage multiplier

items.text: This update brings a huge number of clarity and quality-of-life improvements, as well as loads of bug fixes!
you can now change how large the game is when playing in windowed mode
changes to windowed resolution or fullscreen mode now have a 10s reversion timer

the following things now highlight when hovered: -- hit and stand buttons: -- Player’s ID Card: -- Score Cards: -- Land Card (aka pause menu card): -- draw pile top card: -- small buttons (like back, peek, and swap)
hovering is now a bit juicier, cards will move up and highlight quicker than they move down
hit and stand buttons now have a sound effect
viewing your deck out of combat will now show the state of cards that have persistence between encounters - i.e. Loyalty Card stamps, Baseball Card value
chip text now changes over a short period so you can see it changing
adds a specific animation for spending/losing chips
chip text now turns red while you are spending/losing chips and when chips are 0 or less
hit and stand buttons now pulse their highlight slightly: -- hit button: when there are no cards in play: -- stand button: when score is equal to bust limit
adds a damage animation for when damage is dealt by cards such as Scratch and Trap Card
adds a sound effect that plays when a card's value changes
cursor now correctly scales to resolution, and is correctly set on start up too
background now fades between the old and new floor on floor transition
rebalances the volumes of some of the music and sound effects
default volume is now 2 instead of 5
ensures that if you have no cards in play pile, discard pile, draw pile, or hand you may still stand: prevents interaction with cards during the damage animation
Glitched Card now lists what the on play effect it copied did
Glitched Card can now get any obtainable card (i.e. its pool now includes Tarot cards)
reworks the way that mystery card reward works, now includes a wider pool of cards
fixes a bug where the card description would get stuck on screen when hovering a card created by another card that was being moved into the draw pile
fixes a bug where the opponent would hit once more time after being defeated by damage dealt by a Scratch or X Wheel of Fortune
fixes a bug where card would briefly appear on top of the draw pile when moving to the player's hand
fixes a bug where playing a card that was put into your hand by SD Card could cause a second hit
fixes a bug where Glitched Card copying a Scratch would not result in 3 damage being dealt
changes the descriptions of VII The Chariot and XI Strength to make it clear that they force the opponent to stand
fixes a bug where Glitched Cards would keep art overlays (such as Loyalty Card stamps, Birthday Card candles, etc.) even after switching to a different card
fixes a bug where choosing the colour of the Birthday Card candle would affect the state of the RNG
fixes a bug where Birthday Card candles would be granted for playing the card, rather than according to the value of the card after being played (have fun limit breakers!)
Scratchcard no longer sets its value to 0 on discard
fixes a bug where Gravecard on click effect could be triggered multiple times in some cases
some further performance improvements to do with hovering cards and previewing/choosing from very large piles

items.text: Another batch of quality-of-life improvements that make the game feel much better.
big performance upgrades, in particular this should improve performance with: large decks, when moving lots of cards, and during the damage animation
allow deck/draw/discard/Hall Pass style previews to be dismissed by clicking in the dark region below the cards, or clicking the escape key
card change indicators are not longer shown when previewing a pile
updates Blood Donor description to: On play: Locks. While in play: whenever you play a card worth at least one heart, remove 1 from its value for the rest of the encounter and heal you by 1.
a bunch of tidy ups to the settings screens and reading save game and settings files that fix issues with not being resilient to save game file errors
fixes a bug where if Loyalty Card had a non-zero value it would not set the score to match bust limit correctly
fixes a bug where Wheel of Fortune spinning animation would play when previewing a pile that contained it
speeds up Wheel of Fortune animation
A smaller update this time, tidying up a couple of things after the big Lounge release.
much juicier and more satisfying hit and stand button animations
nicer animation for earning chips
new click animation for the cursor
XXI The World rework:
Now triggers its effect on stand

When it chooses a random Tarot card it will now choose from all Tarot cards that have not been chosen by this copy of The World in this encounter. This means that it will go through all 22 Tarot cards before selecting the same one again, making it much less likely to (for example) draw 2x III The Empress leading you to be stuck with 2x 11 of Hearts locked forever. It also ensures the variety of XXI The World which is really the reason to play it anyway!
Now visually moves the newly created Tarot card into the draw pile
changes art for all suits at once to more clearly be a mash up of all four suits
adds a disabled theme so buttons look better when disabled after clicking them (i.e. during transition after skipping a reward)
sound volume settings now go back to zero if you click them again while they are 10 (so that touch screen users can reduce the volume)
better alignment of buttons and labels in the settings screen
fixes a bug with the Dark Mage where it could be used with no valid targets to skip the player’s turn
fixes a bug with the SD Card where if an opponent used it the on play effect of the new card would not be enacted
fixes the shop ID Card being 2 pixels lower than all the other ID Cards
fixes a bug where you could set your health to 0 by losing hp in the Sofa Sleeper event
fixes a bug where you could crash the game by clicking the same card twice in the Memory game event
changes the name of the Paparazzi (plural) to the correct Paparazza (singular, female)
potential fix for touchscreen inputs being counted twice in some cases causing the player to skip the next encounter/event

items.text: This release brings a new card and lots of QoL and clarity improvements!
new card: Jack in a Box - On play: Randomly select a suit to change this card's suit to.
adds keyboard controls for hitting (spacebar) and standing (enter)

notes.title: Busting, and the effect of busting is now much clearer

items.text: adds a big red cross to your Score Card when busted
plays a sound effect when you or your opponent bust
a new animation when comparing the Score Cards that makes it clear that you have 0 points after busting
fixes a bug where switching between hovering The Collectors cards very quickly during the Trade Offer event could crash the game
fixes a bug where Jack of All Trades would always grant blackjack effects for 10 of each suit instead of the current value of the Jack
fixes a bug where the double damage granted by XVII The Star would be carried to the next round if the previous round ended in a draw
moves clubs being added to damage to be before XVII The Star and XVIII The Moon multipliers applied
you can longer see the corners of the Booster Pack hiding behind the mystery card reward
clarifies that value doubling from Break Limits lasts for the rest of the encounter
adds Yellow Card and Red Card to the game!
On play: Choose a card in opponent's play pile to mark with a Yellow Card, then put a Red Card into your draw pile.
On play: Burn any cards in your opponents play pile that are marked with a Yellow Card. On discard: Burns.
adds an ‘intent indicator’ to the opponent. This will show you when the opponent has already stood (and cannot take further actions) and what limit they will stand at
finally, a new and much improved cursor!
changes Blank Card effect to: “On 1st play this encounter: choose the value (from 1 to 11) for the Blank Card to take for the rest of this encounter.”
the escape key now pauses the game just like clicking the land card would. Note that this is only possible when the land card is clickable

cards that add a card into the draw pile now insert it to a random position in the draw pile rather than shuffling the whole draw pile. This means that cards like Cue Card and Kanban Card work more consistently (unless of course the new card is inserted between Kanban and the chosen card)
card description updates to match the above change
cards now longer reset their art or suit to the default for that card when discarded
Glitched Card now correctly retains its suit, value, name after discarding
makes the card art of several cards match the recent font improvements
clarifies The Devil description (you need a winning blackjack to deal 6x damage)
fixes a bug where Loyalty Card wouldn’t set score to 21 if it’s value was not 0
fixes a bug where Gravecard that was swapped to opponents side could be rerolled endlessly
Memory card now visually moves the copied card into draw pile
This release brings a new card, buffs for existing cards, better readability, and a whole lot of bug fixes!
every single card description has been standardised to be clearer and more consistent
adds the Social Security Card, which has the effect: 'Adds to your hand. On play: Add a copy of your opponents play pile to your draw pile and burn this card.'
new Dark Flower effect: On Play: Choose a suit and add three Ones of that suit into your hand. On Discard: Burns. On burn: burn any Ones created by this card.
changes Gerald from Riviera's effect to 'On play: Select a card in your opponents play pile and burn it. On discard: burns.'
changes Dis-card effect to ‘On play: Select a card that is in play and discard it without enacting its 'on discard' effect.’
changes XII Hanged Man effect to: "On play: choose a card from either discard pile and burn it."
changes Key Card effect to: "On play: Choose a card from opponent play pile to unlock if it is locked and lock if it is unlocked."
slight tweaks to both fonts and readability of the card descriptions
moves Slime to be before the Loot box event since it is more powerful against smaller decks
changes "burns" to happen on discard
clamps card values between -999 and +999 (also affects things like Scratch damage, Temperence chips)
Booster Pack and Glitched Card now correctly play the 'on play' effect of cards that add to your hand (instead of just being added to hand)
fixes a bug where X Wheel of Fortune would still have the previously granted gift in its description after being discarded
fixes a bug where clicking quickly on card removal shop meant you could still see the previously removed card on the second removal
removes Trap Card unlocking itself on negating damage (from both the effect and the description of the effect)
Get Out of Jail Free Card now sets its value to 0 before enacting its effect so that if it is played more than once in a round it chooses the right value
renames pips with no suit to "no suit" when hovering the Score Card
fixes being able to skip encounters by smashing the skip button on the card removal shop
makes VI The Lovers visually move chosen card into draw pile
Tweaks to Gerald from Riviera's card art
fixes a bug where if you didn't have enough health or chips for a particular choice in the Stay a Night event you couldn't click a valid option after clicking one that wasn't valid
changes Joker to list the card name it is copying from instead of just the value
A quick update to improve balance and fix a few bugs.

This should reduce Alucard-related frustration, and brings Decromancer back in line now that Graveyards are suited as spades. It also gives more counterplay around Trap Card when the opponent has this card.
Valentines Card now burns
Trap Card no longer locks
Decromancer now has 66 health instead of 99
adds a description of the gift granted to the description of X Wheel of Fortune after it is played
makes X Wheel of Fortune visibly move a copy of itself into draw pile when that gift is rolled
Official Trump Card sets its value back to 0 before you make a choice to make it clear what its effect will be - this was affecting subsequent draws of this card in the same encounter
fixes a bug where all the card sound effect audio was coming out of the left channel

fixes a bug where Glitched Card wouldn’t update it’s newly picked value before card effect enacted - was meaning the 5 value didn’t get added before Booster Pack choice when Glitched Card rolled Booster Pack
fixes a bug where Glitched Card would block hitting or standing if it rolled Gravecard and then Gravecard was clicked
I’m back from holiday and back working on the game! Here are the change notes for the latest demo release, v0.11, which is now live on Steam!
This release adds a new encounter, a new event, and changes the way the game is laid out for better readability and use of screen space. There are also a number of balance changes and bug fixes.
Look out for more coming next week!
adds a new event to the Basement - it’s a card removal shop!
new encounter added to the Basement - it’s a familiar face, but with an improved deck since the last time you saw them!
when Glitched Card is the mystery reward card the whole card back will now have the glitched effect instead of just the corners
layout changes so that cards in play are more visible and more cards can be in play at once and still be visible
changes to spacing of cards in hand so that they don’t overlap the discard piles
changes the discard pile to a pile that must be clicked on to see the cards in it (like the draw pile)
lowers the draw and discard pile positions so that text on choices can always be read
makes Slime stronger by adding a Get Well Soon Card and a Get Out of Jail Free Card
makes Alucard stronger by removing some cards that made him bust too often
changes Sweep the Leg effect to “Set opponent bust limit to 20 and your bust limit to 22 for the rest of this encounter. Burns”
changes the value of Booster Pack to 5
Four Mana Seven Seven no longer locks
VI The Lovers now has hearts as its suit
changes the value of XVII The Star to 17
Gravecard now has spades as its suit
add a “final stamp” to the Loyalty Card when it triggers
changes Magic Trick Card to set its value to 0 on play (before choice made) so that it is more clear what your choice will do on subsequent plays
fixes a bug where the first potion from loot boxes could be clicked quickly and it wouldn’t have any effect
fixes a bug where the Loyalty Card couldn’t have its value increased by The Victim Card
fixes various typos

items.text: Version 0.9 of the demo is now live on Steam!
This version adds a new card, a new encounter to The Basement, and improves clarity when choosing from a selection of cards.
Blood Donor Card
Locks. Whenever you play a card whose suit is hearts remove 1 from its value and heal you by 1
Alucard
The Basement’s resident vampire rolls with a deck consisting of lots of hearts, and the Blood Donor Card - so it’ll be a challenge to whittle down his health.

When viewing choices you’ll now see the actual card value and status. This means that you can make better choices when cards like The Victim Card, Blood Donor Card, or Gravecard are in play, and you’ll be able to check the stamps on your Loyalty Cards before you draw them
Card choices now indicate where they came from when choosing, again so that it’s clearer where they came from and what the impact of your choice will be
The Fool now swaps the piles much faster
You no longer have to wait for Gravecard animation to complete before taking another action
Fixes a bug where if Loot Box returned a Memory Card or Old Baseball Card the card highlight would stay as that outline instead of the normal one
At long last, version 0.8 of the demo has just been released!

This version completely overhauls the way that card effects work under the hood. They are now much more consistent and less buggy, especially when card effects interact with each other, and it’s going to be significantly easier for me to add new card effects in the future!
The game is much faster overall, with the card movements animations in particular being shortened: Loot Box event fixes

makes the skip rewards button skip card and heal potions
makes the loot box opening animation get faster as you open more boxes
fixes a bug where more than one "open loot box" card could be dealt if you clicked rewards and skip button quickly
Dark Mage can now be played by the opponent
XI Strength now cannot skip the next opponent round if the opponent had already stood
changes IV The Emperor, V The Hierophant, XV The Devil, XVII The Star, and XVIII The Moon to be checked when round ends
this also fixes a bug where if they were swapped to other player their effect stayed on the first player
changes XVIII The Moon shroud to be checked whenever moving cards
Glitched Card now works more consistently
fixes a bug where Valentines Card wasn't suited as hearts

fixes a bug where you could choose the Beer and a Shot option while having less than 10 health
fixes a bug where killing the opponent using Scratch or Wheel of Fortune would allow them to play one more card before the encounter ending
swaps the Poker Players Jack of Clubs for Jack of Diamonds

items.text: This release reworks the Spades blackjack effect, adds a new event, a new encounter, and tweaks the balance of a few cards. And of course, there are a few bug fixes included too!
New stuff!

Loot Box event!: Is your life missing a sense of pride and accomplishment? Then you’ve come to the right place! Click the button, see the flashy effects, be disappointed by the meagre reward, and then do it all again! At least until you run out of money…
New Basement opponent: Slime: Balance changes!
On a winning blackjack, Spades now grant a shield that lasts for the encounter
Terminate the Tower now immediately plays the card instead of it going into your hand as it was too strong and flexible before
Key Card now locks when played (so that it can optionally unlock itself if there is no good unlock target)
Official Trump Card now costs 5x the number of selected pips to play: Bug fixes!
Joker value now gets reset to 0 before making a choice so that the score card is accurate to score before the new value of the joker is added
Fixes a bug where if opponent played Dark Mage with nothing to burn it wouldn't get moved to play pile correctly
Fixes a bug where the Official Trump Card wasn’t suited as diamonds
Clarifies the winning blackjack effect of negative cards
Adjusts the description of the Card Sleeve to make it clear it affects cards you have in play not all cards in play
Adjusts Sweep the Leg description to make it clear it lasts for the encounter
Version 0.6 is now available on Steam!
This version adds four new cards, a new event, a new encounter, and a few important bug fixes!
New cards!
Card Sleeve: Choose a card that is currently in play and lock that card, then burn this card

Baseball Card: Each time this card is discarded permanently reduce its value by 1. When this card's value is reduced to 0, burn it, permanently remove it from your deck, put a Card Sleeve and an Old Baseball Card in play and permanently add those to your deck
Old Baseball Card: It has no effect
The Victim Card: Adds to your hand. If you take damage while this is in play add 1 to the value of every card in your opponent’s play pile: New event!
Adds the Trade Offer Event: The Collector has his eye on three of your cards, and will offer cards from his deck to trade for them.: New encounter!

The Collector: Be aware that cards you have traded to The Collector and his cards that you declined to trade for in the Trade Offer will be added to The Collector’s deck when you battle him. Think carefully whether you want to allow him to have that card…: Improvements and bug fixes!
The Kanban Card now burns itself after being drawn 5 times to prevent softlocks due to having multiple Kanban Cards
Fixes a bug where I The Magician wasn’t burning
Fixes a bug where shrouded cards weren’t covering parts of the card added after playing (i.e., Gravecard hand, Loyalty Card stamp)

Fixes a gamebreaking bug where 4 Mana 7/7 art had one pixel in the wrong place!: I’m very excited about this release! I had started on the Trade Offer Event and The Collector encounter last week but they weren’t quite ready for release then. Looking forward to seeing how you like the event and encounter interacting with each other, and how that changes the way you approach the trades. Let me know if you want to see more complex events like this in the future!
Version 0.5 of the demo has just been released!
This release is mostly focused on some of the most highly requested changes and improvements.
New stuff!
Adds a highlight effect when score is equal to max score to show that blackjack effect is active
Cards are now shuffled back into draw pile much faster
Balance changes!
Changes opponent AI to respect changed bust limit rather than standing at 17 or higher
Opponents will now stand at 4 below their current bust limit
Fixes Aces so that they can increase back to 11 as long as that wouldn’t cause a bust
Locked cards cannot be discarded anymore
Changes Cue Card so that it cannot send itself to the bottom of the draw pile
Changes Bartender health from 10 → 5
Changes Decromancer health from 130 -> 99
Bug fixes!
Fixes a bug where the game would crash after opponent played a card that plays into the hand
Fixes a bug where if the Cue Card was the last card in draw pile, after sending a card to the bottom the draw pile would appear empty
Fixes a bug where the player could still hit or stand briefly after losing
Please keep the feedback and bug reports coming!
No new Basement stuff in this release, but I've started the work for it so it will definitely be in next week's version!
Version 0.4 of the demo is now out!
New stuff!
Adds the beginning of the Basement to the demo
New Basement opponents: Giant Rat, and Decromancer
New card:
Cue Card: Choose a card from your play or discard pile to put at the bottom of your draw pile
Bug fixes!
fixes a bug that meant the loss screen 'main menu' button wasn't working
fixes a bug where the game would crash if hovering cards while they were being moved to the draw pile
fixes a bug where if you hit with an empty draw pile and empty discard pile you'd be unable to hit or stand
fixes a bug where a Trap Card on both sides could crash the game
fixes a bug where cards in hand would be off centred when hand size was very large
modifies Dark Flower so that it doesn't lock if there are no cards in draw pile
fixes a bug where previewing the discard pile would trigger start of turn card effects
fixes a bug that mean that while XVIII The Moon was shrouding the opponent's play pile you could hover the score card to see their current score
Thank you all so much for the continued support, this game is getting better and better because of the suggestions and feedback that you are all giving.
Please let me know how you like the new enemies and the Cue Card!
There will be more Basement coming soon!
Version 0.3 of the demo is now live on Steam!

I’m hoping to be able to keep a weekly release schedule, especially at this early stage when I am getting so much feedback from you all and learning a lot about what people are finding fun about the game.

Reworks XXI The World: New effect is: Locks. When this card would have been discarded, add a random tarot card into your draw pile
